config.detail: NeMo .nemo archive only. Values below read from model_config.yaml streamed out of nemotron-labs-unified-asr-0.6b.nemo at the pinned revision (tar order: tokenizer.model, model_config.yaml, model_weights.ckpt). nemo_version in the cfg: 3.1.0+7be3e2bf6.

preprocessor.detail: From model_config.yaml preprocessor block (AudioToMelSpectrogramPreprocessor): sample_rate=16000, features=128, n_fft=512, window_size=0.025, window_stride=0.01, window=hann, normalize=per_feature, dither=1e-05, pad_to=0, frame_splicing=1. preemph absent from cfg -> NeMo default 0.97. Identical to parakeet-unified-en-0.6b.

tokenizer_config.detail: SentencePiece BPE inside .nemo (4f9d8986eb094812a3106e13d84db5bd_tokenizer.model). Inspected: 4095 pieces, unk=0, no bos/eos/pad, and only one angle-bracket piece (<unk>). No <lang-XX> tag tokens, unlike nemotron-3.5-asr-streaming-0.6b.

tokenizer_json.detail: No fast-tokenizer JSON; SentencePiece proto only.

generation_config.detail: Decoding cfg inside .nemo: strategy=greedy_batch, max_symbols=10. Streaming geometry lives on encoder.att_chunk_context_size (L/C/R menu), not on decoding.

safetensors_metadata.detail: PyTorch state_dict inside .nemo tarball (model_weights.ckpt, 2.51 GB), not safetensors.

model_card.detail: Multilingual (25 European languages) version of parakeet-unified-en-0.6b: Unified FastConformer-RNNT, 24 encoder layers, 600M params, one checkpoint for offline (full context) and buffered streaming (chunked_limited_with_rc, latency = chunk + right context, 2080ms down to 160ms in 80ms steps, default left context 5.6s). Encoder initialized from parakeet-tdt-0.6b-v3. Language-ID prompt conditioning on the encoder output as in nemotron-3.5-asr-streaming-0.6b; target_lang=<code> or target_lang=auto. Native PnC. License OpenMDW-1.1. Runtime: NeMo Speech 3.1.0.

reference_modeling_code.detail: Both halves already exist in the parakeet port: the buffered chunked_limited_with_rc streaming path + DCC conv (parakeet-unified-en-0.6b) and the prompt MLP + prompt_dictionary KVs + resolve_prompt_id (nemotron-3.5-asr-streaming-0.6b). New is the combination: the buffered streaming path (emit_buffered_chunk) does not fill prompt.one_hot.in today.

key_fields.encoder.type: Unified FastConformer (offline + buffered streaming, shared weights)
key_fields.encoder.att_chunk_context_size.units: 80ms encoder frames (L menu, C menu, R menu)

dtype.evidence: NeMo .nemo archive ships a float32 PyTorch state_dict (model_weights.ckpt 2,507,285,799 bytes ~= 627M params x 4 bytes), consistent with every parakeet-family variant.

upstream_benchmarks.notes: Offline / full context, explicit target_lang. Streaming on the same set: 1.49 (1.12s), 1.57 (0.56s), 1.75 (0.32s), 2.42 (0.16s). Context only; Stage 7 gates on the measured NeMo reference baseline.

upstream_benchmarks.dataset: Open ASR Leaderboard English, 7 cleaned sets (offline)
upstream_benchmarks.notes: Cleaned AMI/GigaSpeech/VoxPopuli, AA-chunked Earnings22; not comparable with the older uncleaned suite. Streaming: 5.41 (1.12s), 5.68 (0.56s), 6.27 (0.32s), 7.87 (0.16s).
Mean over 44 dataset-language runs, explicit language prompt. Streaming: 11.85 (1.12s), 13.25 (0.56s), 15.24 (0.32s), 19.19 (0.16s). Per-language offline range 3.61 (es) to 21.93 (lv).

reference_rationale: NVIDIA NeMo first-party framework (card names NeMo Speech 3.1.0 as the runtime). The HF repo ships only a .nemo archive consumed by ASRModel.from_pretrained -> EncDecRNNTBPEModelWithPrompt; there is no Transformers class and no safetensors. Offline oracle: asr_model.transcribe(..., target_lang=<code>). Streaming oracle: NeMo examples/asr/asr_chunked_inference/rnnt/speech_to_text_streaming_infer_rnnt.py with left/chunk/right_context_secs, att_context_size_as_chunk=true, target_lang=<code>, the same script that oracled parakeet-unified-en-0.6b streaming.
known_risks: Combination gap in the C++ buffered streaming path: emit_buffered_chunk (src/arch/parakeet/model.cpp, the parakeet-unified-en path) builds the offline encoder graph per buffer, which now carries the prompt MLP, but never fills prompt.one_hot.in. Stage 4 must resolve the session's language hint once at stream begin and feed the one-hot on every buffered chunk; otherwise the prompt input is uninitialized and streaming output is garbage or silently language-agnostic.

Prompt dictionary aliases are not all the same slot: es -> 3 but es-ES -> 2; pt -> 13 (= pt-PT) but pt-BR -> 12; en -> 0 (= en-US) but en-GB -> 1. The card's documented codes are the bare 2-letter forms and all 25 are present. Stage 2 must confirm which slot the training lang_field (source_lang) actually populated per language; slots never seen in training (e.g. es-ES=2 if training used es=3) will run without error and degrade WER. Advertise and accept only the bare codes (see the --language decision below); region-tagged aliases are rejected.

The 128-slot prompt dictionary carries ~100 locales the model was not trained on (zh, ja, ar, hi, ...) plus region aliases, inherited from the nemotron-3.5 table, and resolve_prompt_id accepts all of them. Decision (CJ, 2026-11-10): --language is limited to the 25 advertised bare codes (capabilities.languages / general.languages). Any other hint, including dictionary entries like zh or es-ES, returns UNSUPPORTED_LANGUAGE; an empty hint still selects the auto slot (127). Stage 4 gates the hint against the advertised list before the prompt-dictionary lookup, scoped to this variant so nemotron-3.5 behavior is unchanged.

Auto mode emits no language tag: the SPM vocab has no <lang-XX> pieces (unlike nemotron-3.5), so target_lang=auto (prompt slot 127) is a language-agnostic transcription mode, not language detection. capabilities.language_detection is false; the runtime must not advertise a detected language. The card recommends an explicit language for low-latency streaming because auto mode can emit wrong-language tokens in the first chunks.

Streaming geometry menu vs model card: att_chunk_context_size is L=[70], C=[1,2,7,13], R=[0,1,2,3,4,7,13] (the training sampling menu, not an inference constraint; NeMo's streaming script builds the mask from arbitrary seconds). The card's 0.56s recommendation (C=2, R=5) is off-menu and resolve_buffered_stream_geom rejects it today. Decision (CJ, 2026-11-10): Stage 4 replaces the menu-membership check with exact-80ms-multiple, C>=1, L>=0, R>=0 validation, verified byte-equal vs NeMo at (5.6, 0.16, 0.40)s on this variant AND on parakeet-unified-en-0.6b (shared code path). Off-menu accuracy at extremes (L<2s per the card, L>5.6s untrained) is a model property to document, not a runtime error.

Buffered streaming recomputes the left context every chunk (card's own 'Streaming Inference Limitation'); no K/V cache reuse. Cost per chunk scales with L+C+R (70+13+13 frames at the default), so low-latency settings (C=1) are many times more expensive per second of audio than the cache-aware nemotron-3.5. A perf property, not a correctness one, but it bounds what Stage 6 can show for 160ms latency on the weak rig.

Offline long-form: with_rc variants are excluded from the parakeet [256,256] local-attention load-time default (rule requires att_context_style=regular), so offline inference is full attention, quadratic in length, as on parakeet-unified-en-0.6b. Trained on <=40s utterances. The encoder is v3-initialized, so the v3 long-context implicit-language-drift finding may apply less here because the prompt pins the language, but long-form behavior is unmeasured.

NeMo version: cfg was written by NeMo 3.1.0; scripts/envs/parakeet pins nemo-toolkit 2.8.0rc0 (6967f48fda2a). The env already loads EncDecRNNTBPEModelWithPrompt (nemotron-3.5) and the converter has a _DirectNemoArchive fallback for att_chunk_context_size (unified-en), but whether that NeMo can instantiate the combined class + with_rc encoder and whether its speech_to_text_streaming_infer_rnnt.py accepts target_lang is unverified. If not, Stage 2 needs a separate env pinned to NeMo Speech 3.1.0 (repo moved to github.com/NVIDIA-NeMo/Speech).

Tokenizer changed again: 4095 pieces (unified-en 1024, nemotron-3.5 13087, v3 8192); blank = 4095. The converter profile needs expected_vocab_size=4095 and the joint output dim is 4096. The vocab includes Cyrillic/Greek pieces; WER scoring for el/bg/ru/uk needs the multilingual normalizer path used by the FLEURS matrix sweep.
aux_ctc block absent from the cfg (unlike nemotron-3.5); expect no ctc_decoder.* tensors. Convert should fail fast if any appear rather than silently dropping them.
No CTC head and plain RNN-T joint (no durations): same head as parakeet-unified-en-0.6b and nemotron-3.5; already handled by head_kind=rnnt.

Encoder frontend is per_feature normalized (offline-style), unlike the cache-aware nemotron variants (normalize=NA). In buffered streaming the per-feature stats are computed over each buffer, matching how unified-en already streams; must stay that way for this variant.
License: OpenMDW-1.1 (same as nemotron-3.5; unified-en was NVIDIA Open Model License). HF card YAML at Stage 8 must carry openmdw-1.1.

intake_gaps.reason: prompt_kernel.0/.2 tensor presence and shapes (expected [prompt_hidden, 1024+128] and [1024, prompt_hidden]) not verified; the 2.5 GB model_weights.ckpt was not downloaded at intake. The converter's PROMPT_MLP_TABLE shape check validates this at Stage 3.

intake_gaps.field: prompt slot used per language in training
intake_gaps.reason: The prompt_dictionary maps aliases to different slots (es=3 vs es-ES=2, pt=13 vs pt-BR=12). Which slot the training source_lang field hit is not stated. Stage 2 resolves by running NeMo transcribe with each alias on a FLEURS clip per affected language.
Stage 2 must confirm the pinned nemo-toolkit 2.8.0rc0 loads this 3.1.0-authored checkpoint and runs the buffered streaming script with target_lang; otherwise add a NeMo Speech 3.1.0 env.
2.5 GB is the F32 checkpoint size, not measured peak inference memory.
